text:
sam-partners: Heads-up 1 RedWave Models wants to list a Hosted API + a BYOW download. Two special asks: (1) dual-proof: PGP detached signature + transparency log entry, (2) per-country redistribution rights (EU-only download). Need legal + SI + HW alignment before we schedule a joint announce.

rhea-legal: Hosted API straightforward. For BYOW+redistribution we need a narrow addendum: territory clause (EU-only), escrow release trigger, warranty of origin, and retention of signature audit logs for 18 months. Dual-proof OK but require verification steps in contract and a right to audit.

cecil-solutions: SI needs a packaged bundle: artifact.tar.gz, manifest.json, detached sig(s), and a short verification script. For the transparency log, we expect a verifiable inclusion proof (merkle root + entry). If partner claims signed+logged, we must be able to validate both locally.

ana-hw: HW/validation note: If they claim edge-quant performance we want a quant report and to run a smoke validation on XNode next Thursday. Also note: some NIC firmwares change memory perf; test should record firmware/driver versions.

sam-partners: Partner offered this mini-manifest example (sanitized):

```
{
  "model": "redwave-13b",
  "ver": "2026-09-12",
  "digest": "sha256:9f8e...",
  "signatures": [
    {"type":"pgp-detached","key_id":"0xC0FFEE01","sig_blob":"..."}
  ],
  "transparency_log": {"log_url":"https://tl.redwave.example","entry_id":"42","inclusion_proof":"..."},
  "kms_refs": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1111"],
  "geo": ["EU"]
}
```

cecil-solutions: That schema looks good. We'll add a field mapping in SI packaging doc and provide a verification snippet (gpg --verify + tl-client verify-inclusion).

rhea-legal: Contract: add a clause that we only enable EU downloads after escrow confirmation + signed addendum. Also add indemnity carveouts for provenance misclaims and require partner to supply signature verification steps and transparency log endpoint SLA. Draft addendum by EOD Mon.

ana-hw: I'll book a 2hr validation window on XNode Thu and post the slot here. Partner should upload artifacts to secure bucket by Wed EOD.

infra-bot: created ticket PARTNERS-5342 to track RedWave dual-proof BYOW gating and transparency log integration  https://redwood.company/issue/PARTNERS-5342

sam-partners: Launch sequencing proposal: 1) List Hosted API Day 0, 2) Show BYOW as "EU-only coming soon" with gated request form, 3) After addendum + escrow + TL inclusion proof + HW smoke test -> enable download + joint blog + demo. Anyone object?

cecil-solutions: No objections. We'll produce SI bundle template + verification snippet and a quickstart PR.

rhea-legal: No objection. I'll circulate the addendum draft once I have their example manifest + a sample TL inclusion proof.

sam-partners: Thanks. Action items: Rhea draft addendum (Mon), Cecil prepare SI bundle template + docs stub (PR), Ana confirm HW slot (Thu), Partner to upload artifacts by Wed. We'll reconvene after artifacts + draft addendum land.
